build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone model with configurable sphere channels, lmax, num layers, and activation checkpointing
create_mlp_efs_head: create an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress via autograd derivatives from node embeddings
create_mlp_stress_head: create an MLP_Stress_Head that predicts isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components separately then recomposes
create_linear_force_head: create a Linear_Force_Head using SO3_Linear with lmax=1 to predict equivariant atomic forces from node embeddings
create_linear_energy_head: create a Linear_Energy_Head that reduces node embeddings through a single linear layer to predict system energy
